svg.title: Match the media tool to the work
svg.desc: Making new footage, reading an image and transcribing speech require different kinds of input and output. Picture. Generate an image from a description or ask about a visible detail in an existing image. Sound. Turn spoken words into text or make an audio result with a supported tool. Video. Decide whether you need to inspect an existing clip or produce new moving images.
